name: John Doe
feedback_text: I feel stuck in my role. I have been working hard but haven't seen any career growth or promotion. The workload is extremely heavy and work-life balance is poor. I love the tech stack and my peers, but I feel burned out.

name: Jane Smith
feedback_text: Great company culture and fantastic sales commission structure! The onboarding was super smooth, and the leadership team is highly supportive. Looking forward to hitting my targets next quarter.

name: Robert Johnson
feedback_text: Engineering culture is excellent. I feel challenged and get to learn new things. Sometimes the release cycles are a bit tight, but overall I'm very satisfied here.

name: Emily Davis
feedback_text: The work is okay, but communication from management could be better. We often get shifting priorities mid-campaign, which causes confusion. Salary is fair but not highly competitive.

name: Michael Brown
feedback_text: The micromanagement in our department is unbearable. The targets are unrealistic and we are constantly criticized despite working late hours. Very toxic atmosphere and zero recognition.

name: Sarah Wilson
feedback_text: I love working in HR here! The team is collaborative, the company benefits are fantastic, and work-life balance is perfect. The executives really listen to our people-first initiatives.

name: David Martinez
feedback_text: Just joined recently. The onboarding was fine, but the documentation is a bit outdated, making it hard to get up to speed. My direct manager is helpful though. Hoping to settle in soon.

name: Jessica Anderson
feedback_text: I have been in this team for over 4 years without a salary hike or promotion. I feel undervalued and my workload has doubled because other team members left. I'm actively looking for other jobs.

name: James Taylor
feedback_text: Solid work environment and friendly colleagues. Work-life balance is stable, except during end-of-quarter closes. Looking for more options to lead projects in the near future.

name: Patricia Thomas
feedback_text: The role is decent, but career progression pathways are not clear. The learning and development stipend is nice, but I want more exposure to strategic planning rather than admin tasks.

name: Christopher Jackson
feedback_text: No growth opportunities, outdated stack in some legacy services, and a manager who doesn't advocate for us. I feel completely disconnected from the company direction. Salaries are below market rate.

name: Elizabeth White
feedback_text: Decent sales training program and high energy on the floor. It is a high-pressure sales environment, but the team bonding events help buffer the stress. So far, so good.
